units.source_text: 源氏公子等到晓月出山之时，方往谒陵。

en.t: Prince Genji waited until the dawn moon rose above the mountains, and only then went to pay homage at the imperial tomb.

units.source_text: 随从者仅五六人，仆役亦限用亲近之人，不用车驾，骑马前往。

en.t: He took only five or six attendants, limited even the servants to those closest to him, used no carriage, and went on horseback.

units.source_text: 回想当年仪仗之盛，不可同日而语，这就不消说了。

en.t: Compared with the splendor of his former processions, it was needless to say that this could not be spoken of in the same breath.
All the attendants grieved and lamented.

units.source_text: 其中有一个兼藏人职的右近将监，即伊豫介之子，纪伊守之弟，贺茂祓禊时曾为公子当临时随从。

en.t: Among them was a Captain of the Right Inner Palace Guards who also served as a chamberlain; he was the son of the Iyo Assistant Governor, the younger brother of the Governor of Kii, and had once attended the prince temporarily at the Kamo purification rites.

units.source_text: 今年理应晋升，却终被除名简册，剥夺官爵，成了失意之人，只得随公子远赴须磨。

en.t: This year he should have been promoted, but in the end his name was struck from the rolls, his rank and office were taken away, and, reduced to disappointment, he had no choice but to follow the prince far away to Suma.

units.source_text: 此时在谒陵途中，行到望见贺茂神社下院之处，

en.t: Now, on the way to the imperial tomb, they reached a place from which the lower Kamo Shrine could be seen,

units.source_text: 此人想起了祓禊那天的盛况，便翻身下马，

en.t: and this man, remembering the magnificence of the day of purification, swung himself down from his horse,

units.source_text: 拉住源氏公子的马头，吟诗道：

en.t: took hold of Prince Genji's horse by the head, and recited a poem:
